games.name: JIMMY RUN
games.special: Game Lab — first PSEUDO-3D RUNNER cabinet
games.note: Jimmy sprints the On Air studio corridors in full pseudo-3D while the DEAD AIR closes in behind. Swipe lanes, jump sofas, slide under the low ON AIR sign rigs, dodge racks + rolling chairs. 7 perks: rocket, shield, magnet, coffee x2, golden pops, slow-mo, MEGA smash. Full Jimmy+Joe voice mode.

games.name: HOP-MAN
games.note: Frog hops four lanes of traffic to collect snacks. Pac-Man maze logic.

games.name: FLAP FIGHT
games.note: Stomp parachute guys mid-gap. Bounce into pipes. Still a high score.

games.name: CRUSHTRIS
games.note: CC rules: 4-in-line = striped, 5 = colour bomb, L/T = wrapped, 2×2 = fish. Tap a special candy then a neighbour to smash combos.

games.name: SNAKE BLASTER
games.note: Snake with a gun. Arkanoid-style brick targets. Classic meets shooter.

games.name: ANGRY WORMS
games.note: v4 FINAL 2026-07-03: our-turn-only (Angry Birds flow), easy open-ground L1-2, distance+bunkers scale, TROOPER worm (deploys where it lands, 3 aimed shots), flash-detonating deaths (no friendly cluster), ammo budget 2/worm+1, auto next level, straight-to-scoreboard, full sfx. Drag to aim, tap mid-flight for ability.

games.name: DOOM MARI-OH 3D
games.note: Full 3D raycaster. Doom engine, Mario universe.

games.name: PIN-VADERS
games.note: v2 DELUXE 2026-07-06: full pinball feature set around the invasion signature — S-O-S rollover lanes (bonus ×2..×5), two drop-target bunker banks (left arms an ENERGY SHIELD drain-saver, right calls the UFO), mothership saucer with skill shot + 2 locks → 3-ball MULTIBALL (2× scores), laser cannon on a moving rail (ball hit = snipes the lowest alien), spinner, animated lane chevrons, DMD ticker screen, per-ball bonus tally, BOSS MOTHERSHIP every 4th wave (HP pips, descends like the grid). Aliens still march down at your flippers — invasion line still costs the ball. Hold halves = flippers, drag lane = plunger, swipe up = nudge (3 = TILT).

games.name: JNJ: ON AIR IN 10 MINUTES
games.note: v4 2026-08-18: studio replated (clear floor walkway — no more furniture trampling), walk cycle faces the direction of travel, no-battle ending (show goes LIVE and the game carries on — tap Joe to wrap), kettle hotspot fixed onto the drawn kettle, 3 new prop-room clickables, painted in-scene props (lollipop/key/padlock — emoji stays inventory-only), fullscreen + rotate, Bungee cassette font. 154-line real Jimmy+Joe Chatterbox VO.
